links.comparator_used: Head-to-head comparison of three LLM output formats (standard output without explanation, differential diagnosis, chain-of-thought explanation) and no LLM support, with radiologists
links.effect: Chain-of-thought improved accuracy by 12.2% vs no LLM support (P = 0.001), +7.2% vs standard output (P = 0.040), and +9.7% vs differential diagnosis format (P = 0.004)
links.quote: The chain-of-thought explanations are also superior to the standard output without explanation ( + 7.2%; P = 0.040) and the differential diagnosis format ( + 9.7%; P = 0.004).
